items.description: Configurable operational AP alerts delivered by email and SMS, reusing existing OpenWiFi SMTP and SMS components where suitable.
requirements: Entity, Venue and AP scope; named recipients and severity selection
Offline AP, reported NAND/storage faults, radio failures and agreed resource thresholds
Fault persistence/debounce, repeat suppression and recovery notifications
Provider configuration, test delivery and visible delivery failures
Recipient and rule permissions must respect granular user scope
Use existing health telemetry; firmware changes only if a required signal is missing
items.inspection: OpenWiFi OWSEC contains SMTP, AWS SMS and Twilio components; gateway alarm events can be forwarded to Kafka. Sending components alone are not an operational alert policy engine.

items.status: previously requested; implementation plan exists; not yet implemented or enforced
items.description: Carry forward the existing granular user access requirement rather than creating a second work item.
requirements: Restrict users to selected Entities and Venues, with explicit descendant scope
Separate viewing, configuration editing, configuration push and disruptive device operations
Viewer, Config Editor, Site Operator and Customer Admin presets; retain platform administrator recovery
Enforce scope and actions server-side across APIs, lists, searches, exports, clients, telemetry, live events and queued operations
Prevent cross-customer data/secret disclosure and unauthorized copy or move
Audited changes, revocation and direct API isolation tests between two customers
items.planning_note: A role selector or hidden UI action is not proof of permission enforcement. Review existing APIs and the previously prepared user-access plan before implementation.
